title: 由子序列构造的最长回文串长度
summary: 分别从 word1、word2 选非空子序列并连接，求可形成的最长回文串长度；回文必须使用两串字符。
insight: 连接两串后做最长回文子序列 DP。只要回文的两个外端分别来自 word1 与 word2，就保证使用了两侧；枚举这类相等外端并结合内部 LPS。
pitfalls: 两边子序列都必须非空
外端 i 在 word1、j 在 word2
若没有跨串相等字符答案为零

solutions.title: 合并串 LPS 与跨界外端
solutions.idea: 先求所有区间最长回文，再强制选择跨两串的首尾字符。
steps: 字符相等时 lps[i][j]=lps[i+1][j-1]+2，否则取去掉一端最大值
枚举 i<word1.length、j>=word1.length 且字符相等，answer=max(answer,2+lps[i+1][j-1])

code.java: class Solution { public int longestPalindrome(String word1,String word2){String text=word1+word2;int n=text.length();int[][] dp=new int[n][n];for(int i=n-1;i>=0;i--){dp[i][i]=1;for(int j=i+1;j<n;j++)dp[i][j]=text.charAt(i)==text.charAt(j)?2+(i+1<=j-1?dp[i+1][j-1]:0):Math.max(dp[i+1][j],dp[i][j-1]);}int answer=0;for(int i=0;i<word1.length();i++)for(int j=word1.length();j<n;j++)if(text.charAt(i)==text.charAt(j))answer=Math.max(answer,2+(i+1<=j-1?dp[i+1][j-1]:0));return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun longestPalindrome(word1:String,word2:String):Int{val text=word1+word2;val n=text.length;val dp=Array(n){IntArray(n)};for(i in n-1 downTo 0){dp[i][i]=1;for(j in i+1 until n)dp[i][j]=if(text[i]==text[j])2+if(i+1<=j-1)dp[i+1][j-1] else 0 else maxOf(dp[i+1][j],dp[i][j-1])};var answer=0;for(i in word1.indices)for(j in word1.length until n)if(text[i]==text[j])answer=maxOf(answer,2+if(i+1<=j-1)dp[i+1][j-1] else 0);return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int longestPalindrome(string word1,string word2){string text=word1+word2;int n=text.size();vector<vector<int>> dp(n,vector<int>(n));for(int i=n-1;i>=0;--i){dp[i][i]=1;for(int j=i+1;j<n;++j)dp[i][j]=text[i]==text[j]?2+(i+1<=j-1?dp[i+1][j-1]:0):max(dp[i+1][j],dp[i][j-1]);}int answer=0;for(int i=0;i<(int)word1.size();++i)for(int j=word1.size();j<n;++j)if(text[i]==text[j])answer=max(answer,2+(i+1<=j-1?dp[i+1][j-1]:0));return answer;} };
